# Provenance

Based on https://gitlab.com/kurumuz/ns2jb at `81d5bb114c856109dadaf1077d927a9f297fe58d`. Upstream history and attribution are retained.

Adds Windows host support, buffered IPC, acquisition tuning, Pico input and FS export. The native payload is unchanged. Upstream has no root LICENSE file; this variant adds no license for that code.
